def comb_sort(arr):
    # Initialize the gap size to the length of the array
    gap = len(arr)
    shrink_factor = 1.3
    sorted = False
    
    while not sorted:
        # Update the gap for the next iteration
        gap = int(gap / shrink_factor)

            gap = 1
            sorted = True  # If gap is 1, we will make a final pass through the array

        for i in range(len(arr) - gap):
            if arr[i] > arr[i + gap]:
                arr[i], arr[i + gap] = arr[i + gap], arr[i]
                sorted = False  # If we made a swap, then we need another pass through the array
                
    return arr

def max_sum(arr):
    n = len(arr)

    # Initialize two arrays to store the maximum sum of increasing subsequence and decreasing subsequence
    inc = arr[:]
    dec = arr[:]

    # Calculate the maximum sum of increasing subsequence ending at each index
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(i):
            if arr[i] > arr[j]:
                inc[i] = max(inc[i], inc[j] + arr[i])

    # Calculate the maximum sum of decreasing subsequence starting at each index
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        for j in range(n - 1, i, -1):
            if arr[i] > arr[j]:
                dec[i] = max(dec[i], dec[j] + arr[i])

    # Calculate the maximum sum of bitonic subsequence
    max_sum = max(inc[i] + dec[i] - arr[i] for i in range(n))
    return max_sum

def shell_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    # Start with a big gap, then reduce the gap
    gap = n // 2

    while gap > 0:
